_readme: Settings for the hello smoke test. Push a change to the board with:
Every key is optional -- delete this file and hello still runs on its
compiled defaults. Secrets never go in here; see SECURITY.md.
tickMs      ms between serial heartbeats / LDR reads, 50-5000.
touch       raw XPT2046 ADC values at the screen edges, 0-4095. Tune
until the dot sits under the stylus in all four corners.
